profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Mariner Finance
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer/Architect with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Expertise in full-stack web development and a new focus on AI and generative technologies. I've architected production-grade systems across multiple tech stacks. I've designed Microservices, RESTful APIs, and created scalable systems that were deployed in cloud environments using Docker and Kubernetes on AWS.
